scorecard.rationale: The 2023 abstract favors refined sesame oil against refined sunflower oil on anxiety during weight loss. The exact test for p=.011 and arm estimates are unavailable. A same-registration biomarker report matches the companion papers and contributes no additional anxiety result. The earlier injected, inhaled and shared-carrier routes do not isolate dietary oil. The sesamol maze comparison tests memory in a separate animal model. A minimal easing signal remains indirect for cold-pressed oil and Parkinson anxiety. The cannabinoid formulation review traces sesame oil as a vehicle and gives no cold-pressed oil and anxiety estimate.
